edit.description: manager from packageManager, not lockfile presence

summary: the program's package.json `packageManager` field names the manager install spawns and the tool kind reads, refusing loudly where needed and absent
acceptance: a packageManager of pnpm@… makes install and the tool use pnpm; a needed manager with no field refuses naming it
tests: a package manager field naming pnpm makes install run pnpm
a package manager field naming pnpm makes the tool use pnpm
notes: 0100. Which manager the first-install scaffold writes into the field is not in the corpus: raise it rather than pick one. Shares src/install.rs with PACKAGE-JSON-IS-SCAFFOLDED-ONCE and src/tool.rs with TOOL-LOCKFILE-READ-STOPS-AT-THE-WORKSPACE-ROOT.
